feed.title: Album of the day on bandcamp

entry.summary: This album has been a slow grower on me this year. First only the amazing(!) title track caught my... ear... But now, after many a listen, I relly enjoy the whole album. Greatful Dead-ish. In a good way.
entry.title: 2026-06-25: Arboretum -- Let It All In (2020)

entry.summary: Another great discovery of 2020 has been 'A Hidden Trace' -- even though this album _techically_ was released last year...
entry.title: 2026-06-28: A Hidden Trace -- I Like to Make Friends With People Who Like Wes Anderson (2019)

entry.summary: Any new album form Pavement's Malkmus is worth a listen. And this one is his latest -- an exploration of folk!
entry.title: 2026-06-29: Stephen Malkmus -- Traditional Techniques (2020)

entry.summary: Best song is the the title track. (It seems that Johnny Cash thought so too...)
